regest.lead: Friedrich läßt auf Anraten geistlicher Personen das von seinem Vater beinahe gänzlich zerstörte Chorfrauenstift in Hohenburg (... qualiter Fridericus dux, pater Friderici imperatoris, ecclesiam, quae dicitur Hohenburg, ..., in qua requiescit corpus S. Odiliae virginis, per indiscretam rerum invasionem disturbaverit, ...) wieder aufbauen und vertraut die Leitung der Äbtissin Rilint an, der bei der Wiedererrichtung des Stiftes und der Einführung der Augustinerregel Bischof Burchard von Straßburg behilflich ist.

gaps.text: No act type for the rebuilding or re-foundation of a house ('läßt ... wieder aufbauen'); the rebuilding and its stated ground 'auf Anraten geistlicher Personen' are not recorded.
No act type for the father's destruction of the house ('per indiscretam rerum invasionem disturbaverit'), a seizure or usurpation of goods; not recorded.
No act type or role for Bischof Burchard von Straßburg's assistance ('behilflich') with the re-establishment and the introduction of the Augustinian rule; not recorded.
No act type for rebuilding or re-establishing a religious house, or for introducing a rule.
No act type for the destruction or seizure of church property ('per indiscretam rerum invasionem disturbaverit').

findings.description: The rebuilding of the house, the advice of clerics behind it and Burchard of Strasbourg's assistance in the re-establishment and the introduction of the Augustinian rule are omitted. The contract has no rebuilding type, but the advice could be kept as rf:ground and Burchard (candidate B001563) as a rv:Participant reference, for instance on an rv:Enactment or the appointment factoid, and the omission should at least be reported as a gap.
findings.proposal: Add a factoid for the re-establishment (or report it as a model gap) with Friedrich as Grantor, Burchard (urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-B001563) as Participant, rf:ground 'auf Anraten geistlicher Personen', and the community of Hohenburg in rf:concerns.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22784:appointment-rilint
findings.description: The second selector 'Friedrich läßt' belongs to the rebuilding clause, not to the entrusting of the leadership. It identifies the grantor but supports a different act.
findings.proposal: Use 'Friedrich läßt auf Anraten geistlicher Personen das von seinem Vater beinahe gänzlich zerstörte Chorfrauenstift in Hohenburg' only for a rebuilding factoid; for the appointment the subject 'Friedrich' alone suffices.

decisions.finding: The rebuilding of Hohenburg on clerical advice, the father's destruction and Bishop Burchard's help with the re-establishment and the Augustinian rule are omitted.
decisions.reason: The passage 'Friedrich läßt auf Anraten geistlicher Personen das von seinem Vater beinahe gänzlich zerstörte Chorfrauenstift in Hohenburg ... wieder aufbauen' and 'der bei der Wiedererrichtung des Stiftes und der Einführung der Augustinerregel Bischof Burchard von Straßburg behilflich ist' is central, but no act type of the vocabulary (Grant, Restitution, Enactment, Appointment) expresses rebuilding, re-establishment, the introduction of a rule or destruction without changing the historical meaning. Attaching Burchard to the appointment of Rilint would misplace him, since his help concerns the re-establishment. No correction; the gaps are recorded.

decisions.finding: The second selector 'Friedrich läßt' belongs to the rebuilding clause.
decisions.reason: The appointment 'vertraut die Leitung der Äbtissin Rilint an' has its subject only in the coordinated opening 'Friedrich läßt'; the guidelines allow a second selector where a role rests on a different passage, and this selector supports the grantor reference.

commentary.t: Die Einordnung dieser Nachricht erfolgte nach dem damals bezeugten Aufenthalt des Herrschers zu Hohenburg (Reg.

). Vgl. zur Wiedererrichtung Hohenburgs auch Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 150. Zum wahrscheinlichen Weg des Königs in diesen Tagen vgl. Opll, Itinerar 10. - Zur Abstammung Rilints vgl. jetzt Will, Les origines, Archives de l'église d'Alsace 37 (1974) 1 ff.
